keyword: how much does a small business website cost
angle: A practical 2025-2026 price breakdown showing small business owners what a website actually costs across DIY builders, custom design, and ongoing maintenance.
secondary_kw: website builder pricing for small business

stats.claim: Real 2025 price tiers for small business websites: basic template sites run $500-$2,000 while custom professional sites run $3,000-$8,000.
27% of small businesses still did not have a website in 2025.
Among small businesses without a website, 26% cite cost as the primary reason.
Squarespace plans range from $16 to $99 per month (billed annually) across four tiers.
Wix restructured its plans in 2025 to four tiers ranging from $17 to $159 per month.
Ongoing upkeep for a professionally built small business site (domain, hosting, routine updates) averages $150-$500 per month.
